Name: Professor Xavier (X-Men) Skin for George (Content Patcher)
Author: chickensoulforthesoup
Description:
Old, crabby George needed a face lift. He's gotten a little bit of mod lovin' but not a lot. Thinking of one of the coolest fictional people to grace a wheelchair, I wanted to zhuzh up George to be Professor Charles Xavier from X-Men. This mod replaces the sprites and portraits of George for the base game (one main version and one winter version). 

You must have SMAPI and Content Patcher (2.3.0 or later) to use this mod.


Want to see more X-Men content? [b]Endorse[/b] this mod so other people see it - it's free to do and really helps me out!

Future updates - depending upon popularity:

--Update name label from George to Professor X
--Update dialogue to reference the X-Men universe
--Make compatible with Seasonal Cute Characters
--Cerebro....?
